subject: Post-call: deployment mode & data residency (EU / APAC) - next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sofie Jensen <sofie.jensen@northbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: deployment mode & data residency (EU / APAC) - next steps

Hi Sofie 	6 thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Call highlights:
- Primary goal: embed Redwood-powered semantic search and summarization into customer support workflows for EU customers by Q3.
- Residency requirement: production data must remain within EU jurisdiction; some teams are asking for proof that no customer content will leave EU without explicit opt-in.
- Deployment modes discussed:
  * Hosted API (Redwood-managed) 	6 fastest to production, we have an EU region (Frankfurt) for EU-only hosting.
  * Dedicated capacity 	6 reserved GPU pools in EU, predictable throughput and no noisy neighbors.
  * Private (VPC / on-prem) 	6 customer-managed networking; required for strict legal/regulatory constraints in a subset of countries.
- Failover/DR: NordBank wants clarity on cross-region routing 	6 if EU region is degraded, what are our options for failover (another EU region vs US/APAC)?

Open items / questions for you:
1) Can you confirm whether NordBank requires hard EU-only failover (i.e., cannot fail over to non-EU region under any circumstances)?
2) Expected token volume / peak RPS for initial rollout (estimating sizing for Dedicated if needed).
3) Any additional security controls beyond SOC2 / encryption at rest & in transit (e.g., HSM/KMS in customer account)?

Proposed next steps:
- I will share a region-availability matrix and our standard SLA draft (attached) for your legal/procurement review.
- Vivek (cc'd) can do a short architecture workshop next week to map traffic patterns and failover policies.
- If you prefer, we can scope a Dedicated or Private offering 	6 I can loop in Solutions + Legal.

Attachments: region-availability-matrix.xlsx (high level), redwood-SLA-draft.pdf

If that looks right, could you confirm the EU failover requirement and a couple of available times for the workshop?

Thanks 	6
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sofie Jensen <sofie.jensen@northbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lars Nielsen <lars.nielsen@northbank.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 17:20:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment mode & data residency (EU / APAC) - next steps

Hi Aditya 	6 thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) EU failover: our legal team is requesting that PII and account-level content never leave the EU for normal operations. For DR, we can consider an exception but only to another EU region. Failover to the US/APAC is a non-starter without explicit Board-level sign-off.

2) Security: SOC2 Type II is required (we have that on the checklist), and we'd prefer to see KMS integration where keys are customer-controlled (or HSM-backed). Can Redwood support customer-managed keys for the Private offering or Dedicated?

3) Timeline: procurement target is end of June; we aim for a pilot in July and production by September.

4) Volume: we'll prep an initial RPS estimate and share by Monday.

Could you highlight what options would be fully EU-contained (Hosted EU region + Dedicated EU capacity + Private VPC on EU infra)? Also please confirm where logs and backups reside for Hosted API (EU only vs cross-region copies).

Thanks,
Sofie Jensen
Head of Cloud Architecture | NordBank
sofie.jensen@northbank.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sofie Jensen <sofie.jensen@northbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment mode & data residency (EU / APAC) - next steps

Hi Sofie 	6 great, thanks for the direction 	6 answering inline below.

EU failover:
- We can guarantee EU-only residency for Hosted API by scoping the tenant to an EU region (Frankfurt) and disabling cross-region replicas by default. For DR, our standard Hosted failover is region-to-region within the same geo (EU -> EU). Failover to US/APAC only happens if the customer explicitly enables cross-geo fallback in the contract.

Customer-managed keys / HSM:
- Private (VPC / on-prem) supports customer-controlled KMS/HSM.
- Dedicated can be configured to use a customer KMS in many cases (depends on cloud provider integrations) 	6 we will validate for your cloud account during the architecture workshop.

Logs & backups for Hosted API:
- Primary copies are stored in-region (EU). We keep encrypted backups; cross-region replication is opt-in and only enabled with customer consent.

Options that are fully EU-contained:
- Hosted API (EU tenant) 	6 fastest, minimal ops, data stays in EU by default.
- Dedicated (EU-only capacity) 	6 reserved GPU pools within EU, better for predictable latency and throughput.
- Private VPC / On-prem 	6 full customer control, suitable if legal requires network isolation.

Next steps I propose:
1) Vivek to run a 60-minute workshop next week to validate traffic patterns, KMS options, and failover policy (do you have 60 mins on Tue/Wed morning CET?).
2) We will attach the region matrix + SLA (attached) for your procurement and legal teams.
3) If you confirm volumes, we'll produce a sizing recommendation and a rough cost estimate (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Marissa will follow up with scheduling + attach the formal region-availability matrix and SLA for review.

Best,
Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofie Jensen <sofie.jensen@northbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lars Nielsen <lars.nielsen@northbank.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 19:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment mode & data residency (EU / APAC) - next steps

Hi Sofie / Lars 	6 looping in next steps from our side and attaching the files Aditya referenced.

Attachments: region-availability-matrix.xlsx, redwood-SLA-draft.pdf

Quick ask: can you confirm which of the following reflects NordBank's preference for initial rollout?
- Option A: Hosted API (EU tenant) 	6 fastest to pilot, EU data residency, Redwood-managed infra.
- Option B: Dedicated EU capacity 	6 reserved GPUs in EU, lower variance in latency, supports customer KMS in most cases.
- Option C: Private VPC / On-prem 	6 full isolation, customer-managed networking and keys (longer lead time).

Please also share any blackout dates or procurement milestones we should be aware of. I'll schedule the architecture workshop for Tuesday 15:00 CET and send a calendar invite 	6 if that doesn't work please propose alternatives.

Thanks 	6 looking forward to the sizing info on Monday.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
